description.zh:
导播台ID。
- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the LIVE console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. To go to this page, choose **LIVE** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio**.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.
The end time. The time must be in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

description.zh:
节点类型。取值：
         
- **Resource**：视频源。
- **Component**：组件。
description.en:
The type of the node. Valid values:

- **Resource**: video source.

- **Component**: component.
The number of programs on each page.
The start time. The time must be in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

The status of the program. Valid values:

- **0**: not started

- **1**: playing

- **2**: finished

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口查询导播台节目单，本接口目前支持的节点类型为视频源和组件。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为4次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query the program list of a production studio. This operation supports video source and component nodes.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 4 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-caster-program --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --episode-id 1872639A-F203-4EC5-8E43-CB92E68F0000 --episode-type Resource --start-time 2016-06-29T09:00:00Z --end-time 2016-06-29T10:00:00Z --page-num 5 --page-size 10 --status 0 --region cn-hangzhou
